author: robiray_
quote: It feels like a mix of The Sims and RDR2 gameplay. Kind of wild that a game where you can just massacre people at random is nominated for GOTY

author: robiray_
quote: This is my first time playing this game. My expectations were high, and they were completely met. I get why it’s held the #1 spot on Metacritic for two decades. Despite the recent review bombing, it will always be the greatest game of all time—not out of nostalgia, but because of the love, detail, and story behind it. It’s a shame that some people refuse to see its value and just leave bad reviews. Personally, I don't think a game with hyper-realistic graphics that lets you massacre people indiscriminately should even be nominated for GOTY
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
